name: Anuj Karoddeo
tagline: I build things and prove they work
about: I'm a software engineer who sits where automation meets AI. By day I build test frameworks and CI pipelines at Cognizant with Playwright, TypeScript and Java, so teams can ship without crossing their fingers.

Before that, I trained CNNs to spot manufacturing defects at Bosch and published IEEE research on classifying white blood cells with Vision Transformers. Biology taught me how real neurons learn; a B.Tech in AI taught me how to build the artificial kind.
I like systems that are fast, observable and boringly reliable. Off the clock, I'm probably in a ranked COD lobby.

highlights.label: RMSE on a live Bosch model
